name: Towne Pump & Pantry

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story convenience store building with a light flat roof, a metal-roof section, and a yellow fascia across the front|A separate fuel canopy with pumps sits between the store and NW Madras Hwy|A large paved lot with marked parking surrounds the building on the front and one side|A gravel and dirt yard wraps the rear of the building|A small detached shed stands at one corner of the lot|A chain-link fence runs along the rear and side property lines, and a cross street borders one edge of the site.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces NW Madras Hwy, with the fuel canopy and a pole sign between the store and the highway|The storefront has a yellow fascia and windows facing the canopy|Wide driveway openings connect the highway to the paved lot|Marked parking runs along the storefront and across the open lot to one side|A sidewalk and a landscaped strip run along the highway frontage.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the end wall of the store, the fuel canopy, and a strip of marked parking along the outer edge of the lot|A small detached shed sits at the far corner beside a planted strip and the property line|The pole sign and the street corner are visible beyond the canopy|NW Madras Hwy runs along the front of the site.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows white exterior walls, a metal-roof section, and a storage container set against the back wall|Bins and stored items sit along the rear wall|A horizontal cylindrical tank sits near the small detached shed at one corner of the lot|A gravel and dirt yard wraps the rear of the building and connects to the paved lot|A chain-link fence runs along the rear property line.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the large paved lot with marked parking extending from the store toward the cross street|The side wall of the building faces the open lot|A gravel drive curves around the rear of the building past the storage container|A chain-link fence runs along the outer edge of the lot|The fuel canopy and NW Madras Hwy are visible at the front.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from NW Madras Hwy through wide driveway openings into the paved lot, which also borders a cross street along one side. The site is a convenience store and fuel station on a corner lot along a multi-lane highway. Circulation space is open in the large paved lot and the gravel rear yard, which would allow for staging and maneuvering on site. The fuel canopy and pumps sit between the highway and the storefront. A horizontal cylindrical tank sits near the rear corner of the lot. A chain-link fence encloses the rear and side edges, and no gates are visible from the imagery.
